definition: InspecVision Ltd., established in 2003, is a UK engineering company based in Mallusk, Northern Ireland.
details: It is a manufacturing company that produces computer vision inspection systems. The company is one of several local companies created as spinoffs or inspired by research conducted at the Queen's University of Belfast.

explainer.lead: InspecVision is a Northern Irish engineering company that builds computer vision systems for inspecting manufactured items. It is also an example of university research contributing to local industrial technology.

tiers.eli5: Imagine a careful factory helper that uses a camera to check whether finished items look right. InspecVision, started in 2003 in Mallusk, Northern Ireland, makes this kind of inspection equipment. It is one of several local companies created from, or inspired by, research at Queen's University Belfast.
tiers.practitioner: A team deploying this kind of equipment would integrate it into a production or quality-control workflow and validate it using known acceptable and unacceptable parts. Lighting, camera position, part presentation and acceptance thresholds need careful control because changes in them can affect inspection results.
tiers.paperLevel: InspecVision Ltd. is a UK engineering and manufacturing company founded in 2003 and based in Mallusk, Northern Ireland, producing computer vision inspection systems. It belongs to a group of local companies formed as spin-offs from, or inspired by, research at Queen's University Belfast.

explainer.example: A factory making small metal parts could use an InspecVision inspection system to examine each finished part visually and route parts needing further attention for manual checking.
